thread:
sarah.m: Heads-up — Acme wants a clean tenant-proof handoff packet for their on-call tomorrow. They specifically asked for 1) an RBAC snapshot (roles + service accounts) 2) audit log extracts showing access to tenant X 3) KMS envelope proof + key rotation record. Can anyone take point? :eyes:
raj.p: I can start the RBAC snapshot. Quick Q: do they want policy versions or just active bindings?
miguel: active bindings + creation timestamps, if available. policy versions help troubleshoot regressions.
sarah.m: good call — include both. customer asked for export that proves no cross-tenant access in the last 90 days.
katie: I can run the audit log query and redact PII before export. Will need guidance on redaction rules for stack traces/s3 paths.
sarah.m: Redact usernames and full ARN paths beyond the tenant id. Keep operation, timestamp, actor type, and resource id (tenant-scoped) intact.
oncall-josh: tagging in case of key material questions — @sec-bot any automated proof artifacts for KMS envelope wrapping we can attach?
sec-bot: [automated] KMS: envelope proof template available at https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/kms-envelope-template — includes key ID, wrap algorithm, and rotation history summary.
raj.p: For RBAC snapshot I'll run:
```
redwoodctl iam export --scope tenant:X --format json > rbac_snapshot_tenantX.json
```
then filter service accounts with `jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("serviceAccount"))'`
raj.p: Will also capture policy_version for each binding.
katie: For audit logs I plan to pull from our GCS/ELK pipeline. Query like:
```
GET /audit/_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ {"term": {"tenant_id": "X"}}, {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-90d"}}} ] } } }
```
then redact via `redact-tool --rules conf/redact-rules.yaml` before handing off.
miguel: KMS: we need to export the key metadata and rotation events. I'll attach a signed statement from the HSM admin plus the `kms-cli` output:
```
kms-cli describe-key --key-id alias/tenantX-root
kms-cli list-key-rotation --key-id alias/tenantX-root --since 2023-01-01
```
sarah.m: Also include the SIEM ingestion proof — timestamped delivery receipts to the customer's SIEM endpoint or our SIEM export manifest.
katie: I have one question on scope: do we include system-level admin service accounts used by platform autoscaling? Those have cross-tenant visibility for infra tasks.
miguel: Include them, but annotate as infra accounts and show example access scopes. The customer wants to see evidence and mitigations.
oncall-josh: FYI vulnerability triage: we discovered CVE-2025-3211 affects the agent that writes audit logs. We applied a hotfix last week and triggered a re-ingest for backfilled events. Should note that in the packet and provide mitigation timeline.
sarah.m: good — add a brief incident-response appendix: detection, mitigation date, verification artifacts, and ticket ID: SEC-4521.
katie: I'll add redaction checklist and a short script to regenerate exports so their SREs can verify locally.
raj.p: ETA for RBAC snapshot: 2 hours. katie ETA for audit exports: 3 hours. miguel ETA for KMS proofs & rotation: 1.5 hours.
sarah.m: Great. I'll assemble the packet and do a single pass for legal-friendly wording. Can someone confirm the export filenames we'll attach?
raj.p: rbac_snapshot_tenantX.json
katie: audit_export_tenantX_redacted.ndjson
miguel: kms_envelope_proof_tenantX.pdf and kms_rotation_log_tenantX.csv
oncall-josh: siem_delivery_manifest_tenantX.json
sarah.m: Perfect. Last ask from customer: a signed statement that no plaintext tenant keys were stored in S3. Miguel, can you produce a short signed note from ops?
miguel: Yes — will get a signed note from ops lead and attach.
sarah.m: OK team — I'll ping the customer once packet is ready. If anything slips, @oncall-josh please triage. Thanks all :pray: 
oncall-josh: ack. I'll keep an eye on SEC-4521 fallout and monitor log re-ingest jobs.
sec-bot: [automated] Document bundle checklist: RBAC snapshot, Audit export (redacted), KMS envelope proof, Rotation history, SIEM manifest, Incident appendix — all required by customer template.
sarah.m: leaving a quick note for auditors: we'll keep original (unredacted) exports in secure evidence bucket `s3://redwood-evidence/SEC-4521/tenantX` with restricted access; the packet contains only redacted versions and signed proofs.
katie: uploading redacted audit export to `/secure-share/acme/tenantX/` and will set presigned link with 7-day expiry.
raj.p: pushing RBAC snapshot to the same folder now.
miguel: uploading KMS artifacts. ops lead signed note attached.
sarah.m: Final: packet assembled and uploaded. Sharing presigned link to customer in a follow-up thread. Thanks everyone.
